auditor_value: maximum in vessel containing liquid A
notes: Independent solve: with the same height h and the same g, P = ρgh is proportional to density alone, so ρ_A > ρ_B > ρ_C gives P_A > P_B > P_C and the maximum is in vessel A, which is option 4. Both mistake entries map to the right options: option 1 is the equal-mass version of this question, and option 2 is the reversed inequality naming C.
